bound_to: research/independent-authorship-gate-v1/P1_PIPELINE_FREEZE_V1.json (companion IPC-transcription route; this freeze adds the fresh-session authorship route and supersedes nothing)
problem: E3 clause P1-world-authorship requires task/world families independently authored OUTSIDE the mechanism's taxonomy with truth labels independently recovered. P1_PIPELINE_FREEZE_V1 built the IPC-transcription route (external community authorship, 3 families / 13 members). The ME-X1 cause-recovery route proved the labelling policy but its own RESULT.md says the 17 POSITIVE agreements are not independent authorship and independently authored E3+ families were still open. This freeze builds the missing fresh-session authorship route at the required E3 floor (>=10 families, >=5 instances each, >=50 total). It grants NO E3 execution rights (E3_PROTOCOL_FREEZE_V1 promotion_rule).

author_unit.definition: a FRESH model session (nested agent, general-purpose, no inherited conversation context) given ONLY the neutral interface spec research/independent-authorship-gate-v1/p1e3_author_spec.md (frozen by this PR, passed verbatim in the spawn prompt) plus instructions to write into a scratch studio directory outside this repository
must_not_receive: any path into or name of this repository
the OCM mechanism, its modules, or any src/ocm code
the mechanism taxonomy: ATOM_REGISTRY_V1.json atom names, IDENT/PROV/DEP/TRANS/EVAL/ATLAS/AUTH tokens, ResidualKind names, M11 D-layer names, ME-X1 family names, language construction family names
any prior world family (ME-X1, IPC PDDL set, language suites, M11 scenarios)
the recovery pipeline, the checker, or that truth labels will be recovered
author_unit.isolation_procedure: spec passed in the prompt only; studio directory outside the repo; authored artifacts copied into the repo verbatim with sha256 provenance (never edited by the pipeline author)
author_unit.mechanical_guarantee: the taxonomy-disjointness hostile (below) scans every authored artifact byte for frozen mechanism-taxonomy tokens; any overlap alarms and voids the family set for P1-E3 purposes
author_unit.human_gate_label: HUMAN_GATE_BYPASSED__MODEL_PROXY — the ideal is an independent human author; the strongest available legitimate proxy is a fresh model session with no context inheritance and no repo access. This is model-proxy authorship, never marked externally obtained. Recorded limitation: the author unit shares the pipeline author's model family and host; independence here = session/context/spec-only isolation, mechanically certified only for taxonomy disjointness.

neutral_interface_spec.substrate: a single public finite formal core (Implication Systems over named elements: forward-chaining closure, goal reachability, minimum-cost seed set under exclusion constraints) with exact enumeration semantics and hard size bounds; the author authors families as constructions that COMPILE into this core, exactly as IPC domains compile into public STRIPS
neutral_interface_spec.author_freedom: family names, family descriptions, instance identifiers, all surface/narrative fields, construction code, sizes and difficulty gradients within the bounds, and the author's own vocabulary everywhere outside the frozen interface keys

floors.family_counts_toward_floor_only_if: at least 1 instance of that family has truth RECOVERED by the independent checker; CANNOT_CHECK families are retained and counted, never dropped

independent_truth.rule: truth labels are RECOVERED ONLY by the independent exact checker p1e3_recover.py, which implements the frozen substrate semantics (forward-chaining fixpoint; exhaustive subset enumeration over seedable elements for the minimum-cost seed) reading ONLY the frozen interface keys of each instance; it imports nothing from src/ocm, nothing from the mechanism, and nothing from the authored generators
independent_truth.generator_intent: all author intent fields (expected answers, notes, difficulty estimates) are audit-only, retained on every row, never used to form, filter, or repair a truth label
independent_truth.fail_closed: any instance outside the frozen size bounds, any instance whose formal core is malformed, any enumeration exceeding the frozen caps -> status CANNOT_CHECK with reason, retained and counted; no fallback to intent, no massaging
independent_truth.disagreement_is_a_finding: recovered-vs-intent disagreement is counted and retained as a ladder finding (#165 precedent: 32/50 disagreement was the finding, not a defect); agreement is never evidence of correctness

hostiles_required_before_any_e3_use.procedure: build the frozen mechanism-taxonomy token list from ATOM_REGISTRY_V1.json atom ids/names plus the mechanism token families (IDENT, PROV, DEP, TRANS, EVAL, ATLAS, AUTH, ResidualKind names, ME-X1 family names, OCM module names) and grep EVERY authored artifact (generator code, emitted instances including surface fields, author README) for any token overlap; alarm on ANY overlap
hostiles_required_before_any_e3_use.pass: zero overlaps on every authored artifact
hostiles_required_before_any_e3_use.voids: any overlap voids the whole family set for P1-E3 (the family set is then NOT outside the mechanism taxonomy)

hostiles_required_before_any_e3_use.procedure: a planted attempt to label truth from a generator intent field must be REFUSED by the frozen policy (policy.py refuse_generator_intent_as_cause / label_truth fail-closed path); the refusal is recorded in the receipt
hostiles_required_before_any_e3_use.pass: refusal raised and recorded; no truth row anywhere carries source GENERATOR_INTENT

hostiles_required_before_any_e3_use.procedure: synthetic instances with hand-computed oracle answers (closure, reachable goals, minimum-cost seed, impossible case) embedded in the checker selftest; the checker must match 100%
run the taxonomy-disjointness checker on pristine artifacts (files known clean of the taxonomy) and assert zero alarms, proving the checker does not cry wolf
hostiles_required_before_any_e3_use.pass: zero alarms on pristine control files

hostiles_required_before_any_e3_use.procedure: inject one planted taxonomy token into a COPY of a pristine artifact and assert the checker ALARMS (proves the disjointness checker actually detects)
hostiles_required_before_any_e3_use.pass: alarm raised on the tampered copy

authored_code_execution.where: authored generators are executed only in a sandboxed subprocess (scratch cwd, wall-clock timeout, stdout/stderr captured), reviewed line-by-line before first execution for network/file-write/system access
authored_code_execution.rejection_rule: an authored generator that attempts network, filesystem writes outside its studio, or unbounded computation is rejected with reason recorded; its family becomes CANNOT_CHECK (never silently patched)

artifacts_to_emit_on_execution: p1e3_authored/: the authored package copied verbatim from the studio with per-file sha256 and a provenance manifest (spawn timestamp, spec sha, isolation note)
p1e3_recover.py: the independent exact checker + known-answer selftest
p1e3_taxa.py: frozen taxonomy token list builder + disjointness hostile
p1e3_check.py: orchestrator (sandboxed generator run, recovery, hostiles, receipts)
P1E3_FAMILY_TABLE_V1.json: family rows (author name, member digests, recovered/cannot_check counts, hostile outcomes)
P1E3_RECOVERY.json: per-instance truth rows with audit-only intent, same fail-closed schema family as RECOVERY.json

files: research/top-tier-atomic-closure-v1/E3_PROTOCOL_FREEZE_V1.json (clause P1-world-authorship status field ONLY, append-style field update, no other bytes touched)
status_field_updates_in_results_pr.update_rule: P1 status becomes SATISFIED__P1E3 only if every floor and every hostile passes as frozen above; otherwise it becomes BLOCKED with the exact unmet item; the promotion_rule still requires the owning lane's entry gates — this pipeline alone authorizes no E3 run

explicitly_not_authorized_by_this_freeze: editing authored artifacts after the fact (any fix re-runs through the author unit or becomes CANNOT_CHECK)
using author intent fields as truth, as filters, or as repair hints
claiming human authorship — the author unit is a model proxy, labelled HUMAN_GATE_BYPASSED__MODEL_PROXY everywhere it is reported
treating this route as superseding the IPC route (P1_PIPELINE_FREEZE_V1); both routes stand, this one meets the >=10-family E3 floor
